name: locked-development-setup
given: A checkout containing shared configuration and tests, uv on PATH, and a populated dependency cache
when: Syncing the locked environment offline and running lint, formatting, strict typing, and setup tests
then: All checks succeed in a separate environment without initializing learner history

name: scoped-tutor-contract
given: A checkout with a development CLAUDE.md, a scoped tutor policy in tutor/TUTOR.md and an optional Cursor pointer rule
when: Running practice tutor check, then removing a rule, importing the policy into CLAUDE.md, making the Cursor rule always apply, or un-ignoring .practice
then: The clean checkout passes and every broken variant exits 3 naming the problem, without creating learner history

name: curriculum-prerequisite-frontier
given: The committed catalog and ordered curriculum with six placed starters, and no learner history
when: Running curriculum check and next, then checking invalid custom maps with unknown references, cycles or missing assignments
then: The committed map passes and next lists Objective 1 and catalog LC1 Two Sum without internal technique metadata; invalid maps exit 3 and no learner state is written

name: source-aware-knowledge-export
description: Export selected public problem knowledge with portable identities and preserved source attribution
given: The committed LeetCode 1 package and registered reference manifests, with no learner state
when: Running knowledge export twice, exporting exactly hint level 2, and explicitly revealing the registered upstream solution
then: Default JSON contains only the statement and repeats identically, hint export adds exactly level 2, reference export retains MIT notice and origin hashes, and no learner state is created; malformed adaptation lineage is rejected before any lineage body is read

name: windows-clean-checkout-verification
description: Run preserved references and complete locked checks using ordinary Windows user temporary storage
given: A normal checkout with uv and locked dependencies, ordinary TEMP/TMP and unchanged long reference names
when: Running pytest with compact unique fixture paths and the independent OS-temp checkout
then: All source bytes copy intact, locked sync/lint/format/strict typing/nested tests and CLI smoke checks pass without learner state; unsupported custom roots produce actionable TEMP/TMP diagnostics

name: verification-command-process-tree-timeout
description: Bound command failures without inherited output-pipe hangs
given: Real Python and uv launchers with child and grandchild processes writing heartbeats and diagnostics
when: The verification command exceeds its deadline or returns a nonzero exit
then: Timeout returns within its cleanup allowance, all descendant PIDs stop and heartbeats cease, and command/deadline/stdout/stderr or nonzero status are reported

name: atomic-catalog-refresh
description: Refresh a real catalog through loopback HTTP and the CLI without changing downstream data
given: A valid catalog snapshot and a real server serving full metadata with distinct internal and frontend IDs
when: Refreshing added, changed and removed entries, then repeating and exercising invalid responses, interrupted/concurrent writers and blocked replacement
then: One atomic snapshot contains the validated entries, full diff and durable coverage flags; failures preserve prior bytes and downstream sentinels, and orphan staging files are harmless

name: problem-facts-verification-input
description: Fetch structured problem facts using real loopback HTTP and the actual command subprocess
given: Invented free problems with Python3 stubs, numbered examples and HTML constraints, plus existing filesystem sentinels
when: Fetching distinct and duplicate slugs with pacing, then receiving platform errors or malformed facts and attempting unsafe output paths
then: All listed examples and math survive with distinct string IDs and raw-response provenance; errors preserve prior files, source directories and learner state, and sourced text is saved only in ignored scratch or external storage
validates: HTML and AST extraction without execution
